en-US.title: UdyamFlow
en-US.subtitle: Bookings for your business
en-US.promoText: Your appointments, customers and payments in your pocket. See today at a glance and act on any booking in a tap.
en-US.description:
UdyamFlow is the booking app for people who run their own business: clinics, tutors, salons, sports courts, therapists and trainers.

Your customers book and pay online through your own branded booking page. UdyamFlow keeps your day in your pocket.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
• Today's appointments for each of your locations, in order
• Who is coming, for what, with whom, and whether they have paid

EVERY BOOKING, ONE TAP AWAY
• Browse upcoming and past bookings
• Open a booking to see the customer's contact details, the service, the time and the payment
• Mark it completed or a no-show, or cancel it, in a tap

BOOK IN SECONDS
• Open any business's booking link and pick a service, a person and a time
• Pay securely through Stripe or Cashfree (UPI, cards and more), and get confirmed straight away

MORE THAN ONE BUSINESS?
Switch between workspaces from Settings.

SET UP ON THE WEB
Create your workspace at udyamflow.com: pick a template for your profession, add your brand colours, locations, staff and services, connect payments, and share your booking link. Most businesses are taking bookings the same afternoon.

Questions? Write to udhyamflow@nextflytech.com.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release: today's schedule, all bookings with payment status, booking actions, and booking with secure online payment.

review.notes: UdyamFlow is a booking tool for small businesses. There are no passwords: you sign in with your email and a 6-digit code. For the demo account, enter the email above, tap 'Email me a code', then enter the code given in the password field (no email is needed for this account). Signed in, you see the owner app: Today shows the demo clinic's appointments, Bookings lists every booking (open one to mark it completed, a no-show or cancelled), and Settings has workspace switching, legal links and Delete account. To try booking as a customer, sign out and tap 'Book an appointment', then enter the code patel-clinic. Payments open the payment provider's secure page in the browser; they are for real-world appointments (physical services), so In-App Purchase does not apply. Business setup and the workspace subscription are handled on our website, not in the app.
